design_philosophy: A vibrant, family-friendly point-and-click adventure blending education with puzzle-solving. Uses chunky, tactile 'game-like' UI components (thick borders, offset shadows) inspired by Hay Day and Clash of Clans, paired with immersive storytelling backgrounds.

layout_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous padding: p-6 to p-12 for containers. Gap-6 to gap-8 for grids.
layout_spacing.dashboard_grid: Bento 'Control Room' Grid for progress and levels. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Use rounded-3xl for cards.
layout_spacing.surfaces: The 'Tactile' Variant: Solid flat backgrounds with a heavy 4px or 8px offset shadow (e.g., shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#1E293B]) and thick borders to feel like a tactile toy.

components.buttons: Chunky and rounded-full or rounded-2xl. Use vibrant primary/secondary colors with a solid dark offset shadow and border-2 border-slate-800. On hover, translate up and increase shadow.
components.cards: White surface, border-4 border-slate-800, rounded-3xl, with playful internal padding (p-6 or p-8).
components.modals_dialogs: Use Shadcn Dialog, but override styles to have thick borders, large rounded corners, and a colorful overlay (bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-sm).
components.navigation: Sticky top bar with glassmorphism OR solid vibrant background. Must include progress, coin balance, and current character avatar.
components.forms_inputs: Shadcn components customized with rounded-xl, thick borders (border-2 border-slate-800), and a soft pastel focus ring.

images.description: Main Menu Title Background - Global map with ancient ruins
Level 1 Background - Jungle and Ancient Ruins
Treasure Chest / Gold Coins for Mock In-App Purchases

icons.usage: Use thick stroke-width (e.g., 2.5 or 3) to match the cartoony UI style.

interactions_motion.hover_states: Interactive elements must bounce slightly (hover:-translate-y-1) and increase shadow depth. Active states must push down (active:translate-y-0) and reduce shadow to 0.
interactions_motion.page_transitions: Fade in with a slight scale-up (e.g., scale 0.95 to 1.0) to feel like entering a new game room.
interactions_motion.accessibility: Include focus rings (focus:ring-4 focus:ring-sky-300). Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

testing.requirements: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='level-1-button', data-testid='iap-buy-button').

special_instructions_for_main_agent: Build the dashboard/level selector using a tactile Bento Grid layout. It should look like a world map or mission board.
The 'Point and Click' gameplay should be full-screen or large 16:9 container, using the provided Level backgrounds.
Overlay puzzle UI on top of the backgrounds using glassmorphism or thick-bordered cards to maintain legibility.
Use Shadcn components but override them aggressively to remove the 'Vercel look'. Add thick borders and hard shadows.
Mock the in-app purchase flow with a slide-out drawer or modal showing gem/coin packages.
Do NOT use pure white (#FFFFFF) for page backgrounds; use the specified background_base (#FEF3C7) to keep the warmth of a family game.
The game is Web/React based, ensure it's responsive but limit image heights to 80vh on mobile to prevent scrolling fatigue in point-and-click sections.
For JavaScript (not TS), make sure Shadcn components are implemented as standard JSX, not TSX.
